status.current: appointed as a Hagun Seven Stars representative

periods.summary: Botan is named by Kurono as one of Hagun Academy's six representatives for the Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival. No in-scene characterization is provided in this volume beyond the roster call.

periods.label: 叶暮牡丹撤退并转让代表权
titles: 破军学园三年级代表选手

status.current: withdraws from Seven Stars after Akatsuki incident and transfers representative right to Shizuku

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Receives tactical advice about firing lines and ally positioning.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Healed by Shizuku after a scrape during training; later helps enable her tournament entry.

periods.summary: Botan trains alongside her twin Kikyo at the Yamagata camp. In a two-on-one mock battle, Ikki defeats them by redirecting Kikyo into Botan, then explains that Botan's firing line overlapped her ally's position; Shizuku heals Botan's small injury. During Akatsuki's attack Botan helps obey Toka's evacuation order, escaping with the unconscious Stella and Kikyo while the student council holds the line. Nene arrives before Akatsuki can finish the pursuit. Afterward Botan withdraws from Seven Stars and joins the others in transferring a representative slot to Shizuku.

key_events.summary: Receives formation advice after the twins' mock battle loss to Ikki.
Escapes Hagun with Kikyo and unconscious Stella.
Is saved from Akatsuki pursuit by Nene's arrival.

periods.label: 报答集训恩情的叶暮姊妹之一

status.current: helps Ikki spar before the final

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former training mentor whom she wants to repay.

periods.summary: Botan accompanies Kikyo to Ikki's pre-final training. Although she jokes about being someone who suffered one of the fastest KOs and may not help much, she still contributes as one of the Seven Stars-level sparring partners who keeps Ikki moving before the final.

key_events.summary: Participates in Ikki's final-day sparring as repayment for his prior help.

periods.time: During the raid on Dragunov's Shinjuku underground arena
periods.label: 贯穿射击清扫地下斗技场

status.current: supports the arena raid with mass-penetration gunfire

relationships.kikyo-hagure: Twin sister; Kikyo opens lanes for Botan's Penetrate shots.
relationships.rai-saiyo: Protects her and Kikyo from King.

periods.summary: Botan joins the raid on Dragunov's illegal arena. After Kikyo draws the charging crowd into a long line and sidesteps, Botan fires both guns with Penetrate, sending twelve bullets through every enemy in the firing path. The tactic collapses large parts of the mob and demonstrates the sisters' improved coordination before King intervenes.

key_events.summary: Uses Penetrate to shoot through massed enemies lined up by Kikyo.
